خذ معك بعض الناس وابحث عن سفينة "ماكسويل" في كل مكان. اقض على كل ما يدعو للريبة أو يبدو وكأنه مشغل.
أمرك!
ماذا تنوي عمله بمشغل "خادور" الخاص بي؟
يا "ماكسويل"، من يصنع مشغل "خادور" فسوف يسيطر على السوق ويملي على الآخرين أسعاره. سوف أجهز خطة لصناعته. وسوف تضطر شركات مثل AMR أو "بيرجر" لدفع أي سعر من أجل الوصول إلى هذا المشغل، ولكني ..
أمر مبدع حقاً. ولكنك نسيتي أن مركز أبحاث "ديب ساينس" قد تمكن من صنع مشغلات أخرى قبل فترة قليلة ولن يكون بإمكانك منع هذا التطوير!
سأكون أول من يحاول هذا (الإيقاف) وسأقوم الآن بزيارة إلى "ديب ساينس".
لن تستطيع فعل أي شيء بجيشك الضعيف هذا. يحتاج الأمر إلى أكثر من بضع سفن وأسلحة جيدة للوصول بها إلى محطة الفضاء.
يا "ماكسويل"، لو فكر كل الناس مثلك فسوف تعيش كل الإنسانية دوماً على الأرض. لا أنوي الطيران بسفينة. قل لكمبيوتر سفينتك شكراً على الخرائط المؤدية إلى كوتهار.
اللعنة!
يمكنك الذهاب الآن. سفينتك واقفة هناك في الجهة المقابلة. معذرة إن كان رجالي قد تسببوا في نوع من الفوضى. يمكنك أن تقسم بعد قليل "بجيشي الضعيف" هذا.
اللعنة! لقد قللت من شأن "اليس".
ألا تريد التعامل مع المحطة بـ ....
علي الذهاب إلى "كارلا ". آمل ان يعمل مشغل "خادور".
سمعتم ما قاله الرئيس. اقتلوه!
اللعنة! ماذا صنع "خادور" هنا؟ الآن مرة أخرى!
آمل ألا آتي متأخراً!
لا! ماذا تفعلين يا "اليس" هل جننتي؟
لا تأخذ الموضوع بشكل شخصي، ولكنك تقف عقبة في طريق مشروعاتي.
علي إيقاف "اليس"، لابد وأن بهذه المحطة بعض نقاط ضعف.
"اليس"! ماذا حدث لك؟
ابدأ المرحلة التالية من إطلاق النار! سوف ... ماذا؟ "ماكسويل"؟
"كيث"!
كيف أتيت إلى هنا بهذه السرعة؟ وكيف لا تزال على قيد الحياة أصلاً؟
أسئلتك كثيرة جداً يا "اليس"! لم يدفع لي من أجل هذا.
تراجع! قومي بتفعيل المشغل يا "اليس"!
ما هذه الجلبة؟ اجعل المشغل اللعين في وضع تشغيل!
ستسمعون كلكم المزيد عني!
اللعنة! لقد هربت! أيمكنك معرفة المكان الذي قفزت فيه يا "كارلا "!
كانت انبعاثات الطاقة أعلى من المعتاد، وقد اختل شيء ما في القفز. لكني آمل أن تكون ما تزال على قيد الحياة.
أردت ان أقتلك يا "كارلا "!
هي لا تزال أختي الصغيرة!
انا قادم على ظهر السفينة.
حسناً، يمكنك إذاً أت تخبرني بما تم فعله بمشغل "اليس" هذا.
ماذا يعني هذا؟ أين نحن؟ اشحنوا مشغل "اليس"!
لم يعد لدينا خلايا طاقة بعد.
ماذا؟ هل أنا محاطة بمجموعة من الحمقى؟ قوموا بتشغيل المحرك.
اللعنة! كيف لي أن اخرج من هنا فحسب!
شكراً يا "كيث"، إن لم تنس ...
أسمع هذه الكلمة في أغلب الأحوال في الفترة الأخيرة. تحتاج هذه المحطة وبشكل ملح إلى حماية أفضل.
لديك حق في هذا. لم نكن نتخيل أننا سنواجه مثل هذا العدو، ولم أتصور يوماً أن يصل الأمر بـ "اليس" إلى هذه الدرجة.
كل ما نأمل ألا تظهر هنا مرة أخرى في الأمد القريب.
ولكني آمل ان يكون في هذا عبرة لها وان تعود في المستقبل إلى رشدها.
سنرى. يبدو ان الأمل سيموت في النهاية. أعتقد انه يمكننا إحتساء مشروب الآن.
هههم، ربما سيقودنا هذه إلى أفكار جديدة. في أي شيء لك رغبة؟
وددت لو أحصل على بيرة أولاً. ألديكم خمر "يامير"؟
أوه، يا لها من أمسيات شرب مع "كارلا ". ربما كان علينا أن ندعو شباب معمل 9 إلى الرهان على مشروب هنا.
أعتقد ان "كارلا " كسبت. أين هي أصلاً؟
ورقة؟ أوه، لا! لدي الآن "ديجافو" غير لطيف.

السيد العزيز "كيث"، كنت ترغب في أمر ما، ولكني مضطر الآن للذهاب للعمل ثانية. حصلت المحطة على نصيبها من بعض الأمور وقد تحطمت بعض المعامل بشكل تام. سأكون مشغولاً طوال اليوم. ولكن ربما نرى بعضنا مرة اخرى.
لم تذهب بلا خبر أو أثر على الأقل. لنر الآن شيئاً جميلاً في المعسكر.
سيد "ماكسويل"، شكراً جزيلاً على تقييم سفينتي التي كانت موجودة معك. فمن خلال مساعدتك تمكنت من إزالة بعض الخلل الموجود في المولد (الذي يعمل بدون طاقة) لدرجة أن المشغل يعمل الآن بلا مشاكل.
جيد ما حدث.
احتفظ بالتيفون من فضلك كنوع من الشكر على عملك الدؤوب. وإن كان لديك اهتمام في المستقبل بسلسلة السفن هذه فهناك موديلات أخرى منها موجودة في انتظارك بالمعسكر. زرنا قريباً مرة أخرى.
سأفعل. بالتوفيق في عملك يا "خادور". إلى اللقاء.
هذا هو ... "كيث ماكسويل"، منقذي! قم بالتغطية وأخرجني من هنا.
لم يتعين علي فعل هذا؟ أعتقد انك رفعت من هنا بالشكل الصحيح.
يا "ماكسويل"؟ لا نريد أن ننسى شيئاً وان تأخذني معك في السفر؟
كان عليك ان تفكر في هذا من قبل. لا توجد فرصة (الآن).
مرحباً! هل يسمعني أحد؟ أريد الذهاب من هنا!
اصرخي كما تريدين يا "اليس" فلن يساعدك أحد.
يا "ماكسويل"! لك مني مليون نقطة إن أخرجتني من هنا!
محاولة فاشلة! انسي الأمر.
مليونان!
علي الخروج من هنا وإلا فربما أتعرض للهلاك.
يا "تينر"! أنت أيها الأحمق! كيف لا تكون لدينا خلايا طاقة كافية على متن السفينة؟ أريد الخروج من هنا!
أ..أعمل الآن على إيجاد حل، ولكن الأمر قد يستمر بضع سنوات حتى يتم جمع طاقة بشكل كاف.
بضع سنوات؟ أنت تمزح بالتأكيد!
كيف حالك اليوم يا "اليس"؟
لا تستثيرني يا "ماكسويل"! لو وقعت في يدي فسوف ترى!
علي القيام بتعريجة كبيرة حولها (حول يديها) إذاً.
يا "ماكسويل"! أخرجني من هنا فلم أعد أحتمل الأمر!
اقضي وقتك مع "الفويدز"! فأنا هنا من اجل المعدن فحسب.
هنا سفينة جاهزة منها هناك.
"ماكسويل"، أنت مرة أخرى؟ هل جئت إلى هنا لتسخر مني فقط؟
معذرة يا "اليس"، لا وقت لدي للحديث. أنا في الطريق عائداً.
How are you today, Alice?
Don't play with me, Maxwell! If I get my hands on you, you're dead meat!
Oooh, then I better steer clear of you.
Maxwell! Get me out of here, I can't stand it anymore!
Why don't you pass the time with the Voids? I'm just here for the ore.
Boss, a ship is approaching!
Maxwell, you again? Are you just coming here to taunt me?
I'm sorry, Alice. No time for chit-chat. I'm just passing through.
Hi Keith!  We're transferring the Deep Science team back to Thynome. Kothar station is still being repaired from the battle with Valkyrie.
A sound plan! How about I pick you up so we can make the journey, um, uninterrupted.
Hi Lovey! Are you ready to take me to Thynome?
Hey, I'll take you anywhere if you ask me nicely like that!
I can't wait to see my new living pod. There's a flotation tank, and a quad-sized bed!
A quad-sized bed, now that sounds like fun!
You know, Keith, I've been thinking...
Uh oh... Why do I get a bad feeling about this...
Stop it, silly! Isn't it time we got a little more serious? I mean, us, taking our relationship to the next level? You could move in with me on Thynome, there's plenty of room...
Hey, if you cook and I can drink beer, I'm all up for it.
Oh great! Now we should discuss decor. I've been looking through the scans for the perfect curtains...
Oh yeah... Curtains... My favourite subject.
A few months later...
Carla, I'm heading off. See you when I see you...
Hey, not so fast! Where are you going?
Well, you know, Carla, there's always work to be done... I need to make a living... Space to be explored and all that...
But you have enough to do here, Keith! We need to finish renovating our suite... The permit for our partnership augmentation could be approved any moment now!
I should really get going, Carla... You know how to reach me... I'm sure I heard of pirates in some zone or other...
Don't give me that crap, mister! We're having dinner with the Tweezleboks later. They just had a new extension put on their pod!
Oh the Seven's bells! I hope something happens somewhere... Soon!
Meanwhile in Midorian space...
Keith, Keith! Do you read me?
Gunant! Long-time no see! How are you?
Keith! You must save my son! There is a most dire situation unfolding and I am trying every recourse...
Calm down! What's going on exactly?

My son, Gunant IV, and his crew are on a damaged freighter deep in the Valpatro orbit and we can't get a vessel close enough to make an extraction. Your ship might be able to infiltrate the area and stage a rescue operation.
Okay. But what happened to the freighter?
It seems the sun of the Ginoya system exploded and devastated the inner planets. Nothing like we've ever seen. We're receiving distress signals from several of our mining outposts in that area.
I see. That is serious. I'll do my best to save them.
Be sure to bring enough passenger cabins! There are ten miners on board. Please, hurry!
Oh, wow! This really is bad. It's like a tanning salon gone haywire!
The gamma rays are off the scale! I'll need to hurry before my hull is incinerated!

The station has been obliterated!
I hope those guys are still alive. Does anybody read me?
Yes, we're here! Dock on as fast as you can. We have casualties and the whole ship is about to break apart.
I'm on my way!
Everyone hurry, get on board!
That's the last one, let's get the injured to Tadram, fast!
Hold tight in the passenger cabin! We're on our way, and not a second too soon!
That was a close call!
Hailing approaching vessel. Tadram station has become unstable due to the gamma rays. Docking is no longer possible.
Listen, I have ten Midorians from Valpatro on board who need medical treatment. Can I leave them on your freighter?
Yes, of course. We can take care of them. But be quick, as we're preparing to depart for Talidor, where it's safe.
That radiation! I don't have much time. I need to dock at the freighter.
What the... we've got company!
I've never seen such ships before.
Whoa. Where did they go? Some kind of cloaking device?
I'd better handle these guys so the freighter can make its getaway.
Captain, that was the last of them! Safe journey to Talidor.
Well done! Over and out.
Gunant, do you read me?
Keith, have you any news on my son?
Your son is safe and on his way to the Talidor system. But the situation looks bad. It's like we're dealing with some kind of supernova.
Thanks for saving my son, Keith. Our scientists are speculating that the whole Mido sector could be at risk of burning up. Many stations and some entire planets need evacuating!
Who is coordinating the operations? I'd like to help any way I can.
That's very noble of you, Keith! Bargand Surr is in charge. You can find him in the Talidor system in Midantha.
I'd better be on my way then. Take care, Gunant.
Keith T. Maxwell! I wanted to personally express my gratitude for your selfless and courageous act in saving the miners.
Hey, I like to give back once in a while! I can see that this is a time of great need for the Midorians, so you can count on me as a volunteer in your efforts.
Back at Tadram station I was attacked by several unidentified vessels, can you tell me anything about this?
To be honest, we're flummoxed. It could be that some outlaw elements are trying to take advantage of the current chaos for their own gain.
Well, they were certainly too technologically advanced for pirates. I've never encountered stealth ships like these.
Stealth ships? Ah, that's why we've recently had several reports of sightings of strange vessels in our systems. This is all quite worrying...

But we should first look to the urgent matters at hand! We could use you at the Luur station where a hundred crew are in need of immediate evacuation. Would you be willing to undertake such a large operation?
Like I said, I'll help how I can, but I'll probably need hull enhancements before going back out in that gamma storm...
We've thought of that already. We'll provide you with a gamma shield. This should afford you more time in the affected zone.
And for protection, look in the hangar for our latest turret. You might need one just in case there's a repeat of the last incident.
Great, Bargand. I'll equip the shield right away and check out this new turret. Then I'll head straight to Luur station.
Maxwell hailing Midorian freighter. Bargand Surr sent me to support the evacuation. Who's in charge here?
Captain Squand here. We really could use your help right now! We need to get the entire crew off the damaged station and onto the freighter.
Okay, I'm on the task.
These guys again! It seems like they're trying to disrupt the evacuations.
Hailing unknown vessel. This is a rescue operation, turn around immediately or you will be fired upon!
No answer. Well, they asked for it.
We have all the crew on board and can now depart the orbit. Thanks and good-bye, Mr. Maxwell!
Hailing Bargand Surr! Come in! The evacuation is complete, everyone is safe.
Well done, Mr. Maxwell! Your assistance is proving invaluable.
You're welcome, Bargand! But your problems are worsening at the moment. There must be a direct relation between the gamma ray bursts and the arrival of the stealth fighters.
That's what we are currently assuming. There is news pouring in of more widespread attacks. We have made contact with the Terran Fleet Commander, Brent Snocom, in an urgent request for aid.
Snocom is a good man. He won't turn a blind eye to this mess.
Don't forget that there is a Nivelian embargo on our faction. The Terrans might prefer to maintain their volatile peace with the Nivelian Republic.
I'll fly to Alioth station at once and talk to Snocom. I'm sure something can be arranged.
Meanwhile, back on Thynome station...
I wish I could get a signal to Keith, but the gamma ray interference is jamming all communications. How am I supposed to match these curtain proposals by myself?
Professor Paolini? We have two new visitors on board who wish to speak with you, a Professor Moonsprocket and a Doctor Lampeter?
What? Moonsprocket? Oh no! What's he doing here!
Professor Paolini! How nice to see you again!
Professor Moonsprocket! You've returned to us! I didn't think we'd see you around here again after what happened last time!
What's that? No recollection at all, my dear! I've come because of the anomaly in the Midorian sector. I believe I may have some valuable information on the matter.
The supernova? Well, I suppose we can accommodate you, but we may have to keep the lounge off-limits for the time being, for all our safety... May I ask who is accompanying you on your visit?
What? Yes, of course! Allow me to introduce my psychiatrist, Doctor Brillo Lampeter.
A pleasure to make your acquaintance. I am acting as assistant to the illustrious archaeologist, Professor Thadellonius Moonsprocket in all his psychological and pharmaceutical needs!
That's, um, reassuring ...
Oh, Carla! I've just heard rumour that that awful man Moonsprocket is back on the station! Ah, oh... oh dear! Hello, Professor!
Khador, my old chum! Just like the old days, yes? How nice to see you! I hear you have been working hard at finding the cause of the disturbances? Come to the same conclusion yet? Eh? Eh?
Well, yes, I suppose... All indications point to a correlation with an early-stage supernova, although this would be impossible given the age of any of the stellar bodies in this sector...

Haha! Spot on, old chap! Listen, I may have just the thing for you to solve the problem. Now where did I put it...? Damned, it was a rectangular thing. All this space travel does make me dizzy. Maybe a drink will jog my memory! What do you say, Brillo?
Indubitably, Professor!
Just what I need right now! I hope Moonsprocket doesn't go berserk like last time. I'll have to put my management skills on full alert, and keep him away from Khador before sparks start flying!
Hello, Brent! I've heard that Bargand Surr asked the Terran Fleet for help.

Hi, Keith! Yes you are correctly informed. We've discussed the issue and decided to send carriers with drop ships to aid in the evacuations. The Nivelians, however, won't be pleased about this, so we're expecting some kind of fallout. What can you tell us about the Midorian situation?

It looks bad, I'm afraid. Their stations are taking a hammering from the intensity of the gamma rays, and stealth fighter attacks are disrupting the rescue efforts. The Midorians have barely had a chance to catch their breaths yet.

The Deep Science team is working day and night to find a solution to the anomaly. It's playing havoc with our communications, so we can't tell for certain what's going on either. But the stealth fighters are another thing...
I couldn't get any signature from them. I can't even venture a guess where they're from.

We've been contacted by the new leader of the Nivelian Republic, Trunt Harval, former Security Chief. He assumed political and military leadership at the same time as the disruption of the supernova. Surprisingly they offered to help with the evacuations. He also mentioned stealth fighters sighted along the shared Midorian border.
Hmm. I'd like to speak to him personally if it's possible. Maybe he can provide more information on these stealth fighters.
I'll make an appointment for you. He's at Genoh in the Gesla system at the moment.
Thanks, Brent. I'll see you. Bye.
Take care out there, Keith!
This is Keith T. Maxwell. I'm here under a diplomatic flag to meet Trunt Harval.
Mr Maxwell. We appreciate your visit. We are currently indisposed, however, due to heavy pirate attacks. Please feel welcome to call again at a later time.
Ugh, no time to waste. I should lend a hand...
That was the last of them.

Thanks for getting rid of that scum, Mr. Maxwell. Unfortunately due to pirate activities, Trunt Harval has temporarily relocated to the Paréah system. Please proceed to Katashán where chief director Harval awaits you!
He could have told me earlier...
Welcome, Mr Maxwell. I am Trunt Harval, chief director of the Nivelian Republic.
Keith T. Maxwell. A pleasure and an honour.
Likewise. I've come to hear that you have encountered these stealth fighters?
Yes, that's why I came here. Perhaps we can compare notes.
That's an excellent thought. Do you have any thoughts as to their origin?
Not a clue. But I do know how to tackle them!
You do?
Hah, they'll have to try harder to bring me down! They have the stealth technology which makes them a bit annoying - definitely not just your random pirate.
You fought them, and... survived? This is interesting. You must have many gods of fortune on your side, Mr. Maxwell!
It was easy enough. They weren't too tricky, despite the disappearing act. How about your guys? How have they fared against them?

We thought their stealth capabilities gave them a competitive edge. But it's good to know that there is a way to counter them. I'll have to inform my fleet. Well, look how the time passed. I'll better not keep you any longer. Goodbye, Mr. Maxwell.
My time? Oh... He's gone. Must be a busy man. Hmm, I didn't find out much from this meeting but at least I won their hearts and minds. Better get back to Brent and report.
Meanwhile back on Thynome station...
Ah, there you are, Doctor Paolini!
Professor, hello!
I've found it! I found my ancient data stick!
What on Janice's Satellites are you talking about?
My data stick! It's an oblong form of physical memory. It was very deep in the pocket of my other trousers...
Excuse me? I think I've heard quite enough crudity for one meeting, Professor...
No, wait! It's just a kind of obsolete storage! I simply need to find the right object to insert it into! Just look at it! Oh no, where did it go now... It's in here somewhere!
Professor Moonsprocket... We had plenty of your antics here last time and you were asked to leave before, I'm afraid I'll have to do so again.
But... But I'm only trying to help! This could be of tremendous importance!
You're not being helpful, you're being weird. Please leave.
I... I suppose I should go then. I'll leave the data stick here on your desk... See? If you get the opportunity, please take a look at it. You'll find me at the bar.
Okay, well, maybe I'll look at it later... goodbye, Professor.
What's going on? Stealth fighters! And they're gunning for me!
I thought they would only loot evacuation ships. I'll need to be on my guard...
Ah, Keith! So how did your meeting go with Trunt Harval?
Well, rather strange, I'd say. Trunt Harval is polite, and was certainly interested in hearing about my exploits, but he seemed to be preoccupied with something.
Preoccupied?
It seemed he was very surprised that I survived and even destroyed some stealth fighters...
Maybe he was entranced by your famous charisma?
What? I don't think so. I just can't put my finger on it. But never mind. What's new with our Midorian friends?
We're about to send another carrier with dropships to evacuate Tadram. But we're still having trouble with stealth fighter attacks.
I can pitch in on the effort if you can use me. If I go home to Carla, it'll just be domestic chores.

That would be of great help. Mind that the dropships are the most vulnerable part of the procedure. They need to be protected during the operation. We'll transfer a repair beam to your cargo hold. Use it to patch up damaged ships.
I'll do that! See you later, Brent.
Maxwell, good you've come! The evacuations have already begun. Everything appears quiet so far.
The dropships are transporting evacuees from the station to the carrier.
If you have a repair beam installed, be sure to stay close to damaged dropships so it can do its work.
Here they come. Remember, protect the dropships at all costs!
Damn it, we lost the first dropship.
There goes another one. I must concentrate my efforts on the dropships.
Ah hells! With only one dropship left, this evacuation is going to take forever!
We did it! Everyone's on board. Thanks for your help, Maxwell. Carrier crew, prepare to jump.
They should be safe now, time to jump out of here.
Keith, please come in!
Ah, Carla!
Finally, I got through to you! It's so good to hear your voice. Are you okay?
No need to worry, Carla. You know I'm a big boy and can take good care of myself.

I know, but still... I haven't seen you in ages. Please come back to Thynome. I... we need you here. We've worked out a plan to reverse the supernova, and I need your feedback on some curtains I found.
Curt...? Ugh, okay, I'm on my way.
Ah Keith, there you are! I'd love for us to have some time together, but there's vital work to be done... We'll discuss the curtains later... but now, let Khador explain the plan...

Thank you, Carla. Upon following the gamma ray burst patterns, our readings suggest that what we are experiencing is indeed a phenomenon similar to what you humans would call "supernova". These have never been observed at such proximity, however, so this is purely conjecture.
This must be a very early stage example. I believe that whatever caused the imbalance in the star's integrity can be reversed before destabilizing the entire sector.

I have built a reverse matter core generator into the largest missile available to us in order to contain and shield it from instant incineration. The idea is to create, in effect, a miniature black-hole inside the star to cancel the proliferation of energy production.
I wish I had a skip button of my own...
Our current predicament is that we have had to reduce the propulsion system to a bare minimum to allow enough room for the generator.
Which means we need someone to fly in close enough to release it at close range.
Ah... Okay... I was wondering where I came into all this... You were starting to lose me there, Khador!

Your ship is equipped with the best gamma ray protection currently at our disposal. However, we need to make some improvements. By consulting these blueprints I am now making available to you, you can help us in completing the shield enhancements, so we may commence the mission forthwith.
Okay, well, there are some extra materials to get, I see. I guess if you want the job done right, I'm your man!

Ah Keith, the gamma shield is fully prepared! We should lose no more time in fulfilling our task. Your ship is being fitted with the missile as we speak. Please, try to release at the optimum proximity, or else the missile may not reach the star!
The components for the matter core generator were extremely difficult to attain. A second opportunity may not present itself to us!
Don't worry, Khador. I'll make sure the missile gets to where it needs to be.
I will be accompanying you on this mission to ensure as much, although I will remain purely in an observational capacity.
Let's just hope this doesn't turn into a running commentary.
Well, maybe we can make this the last dangerous mission. You can't expect me to be here worrying about you all the time while you're away flying into suns!
Relax, Carla. Really, this is what I'm meant to be doing. The Midorians are depending on us right now to sort out this mess.
How exciting! I am very much enjoying the prospect of witnessing the spectacle first-hand!
This is as far as the gamma rays allow us to go. You're on your own from here!
Okay, now we just have to get near enough.
We will be priveleged with a unique view of a controlled supernova implosion, and perhaps the first documented life-forms to achieve such a feat.
Yeah, well let's just see what happens first, okay? We can hypothesize about it later.
Stealth fighters! They're crazy to get in this close to the supernova! They must be intent on stopping us.
So these are the bullies who have been hampering the Midorians! Have at them, Mr. Maxwell
Okay, I hope we get there soon. My eyes are hurting from all this gazing at the sun.
Here it goes... Bombs away!
This doesn't look right at all. It seems like the supernova got even bigger!

Oh dear, this is certainly not as we planned. It appears the supernova has taken an adverse effect to the reverse matter core generator and has absorbed it as a fuel, flaming the phenomenon at an accelerated rate!
How could I have made such an obvious error? We should return to Thynome at once. I'm afraid I must face my colleagues in disgrace.
Hold on there, Khador. There's one of those stealth fighters. His radar must have been damaged by the energy burst, he doesn't seem to notice us...
A good opportunity to follow him and get to the bottom of this.

On second though maybe not...
Let's get back to Thynome, for now.
Keith, thank the goddesses you're safe! I got such a fright!
Yeah, well that proved to be a very interesting trip on a number of levels. Khador is taking it all quite badly, I think he might need time to recover.
It seems that he has locked himself in his lab. I imagine his scientific pride has taken a massive blow.
While Khador's out of commission, do you have any other ideas for counter-measures? This could escalate the Midorian situation.

Yes, actually, we do have something. Out of desperation I consulted some data that a visiting archaeologist left behind. A certain Thadellonius Moonsprocket. It seems he was on to something. His data stick contained construction plans for a kind of plasma array for depressurizing supernovae...
Data stick... Hehe...

This plasma array is apparently capable of projecting anti-anti-matter over large distances. But the technology is from an ancient extinct race. So far as we know, only Moonsprocket can tell us more about the anti-anti-matter!
You're stuttering...
Keith, we need you to find Moonsprocket for us. He's travelling with his Bobolan psychiatrist, Brillo Lampeter, and from what he said, probably drowning his sorrows in some space lounge.

Hey, hold on here! You want me to go crawling around space lounges while all this other stuff is going on? Carla, really, I have more important things to be doing. Are you perhaps trying to keep me out of trouble?

Keith, this is important. We don't have any other good ideas at the moment. This plasma array might just work. This supernova could make the entire Midorian sector uninhabitable for millennia to come!
Alright! I get it! Why do you always have to be so melodramatic!
So you'll do it! Thank you, darling. I'd suggest you pick up the trail at the start of his latest binge, here in our space lounge, I suppose.
Yeah, well hopefully I don't run into any unpaid tabs on this mission. Sheesh.
Good luck, Keith! And try not to get too drunk!
Meanwhile in the Midorian sector...

Commander Snocom, we thank you for your enduring support through this crisis. With this new turn of events, however, our prospects appear extremely bleak. The supernova area of effect is spreading to all neighbouring systems.
Bargand Surr, we will continue to do all we can to ameliorate your current crisis. The Midorians will endure as a faction, and I extend our commitment to this end.

While encouraging to hear that we are not alone in our tribulations, I am also faced with the cold realities of our tenuous position. The powers of the galaxy seem to be in unison against us. I can only hope that our dream of a Midorian future is not shattered in this trial by fire.

I ask you to take consolation in the fact that our top scientists are working around the clock to find a new solution to the supernova threat. And we have our best man, Maxwell, assisting them at this very moment...
Yo, barkeep! What's happenin'? You seen Moonsprocket and Lampeter?
Those guys? Nah. They're personae non grata here... Made it into my red book. I'd reckon they've gone to Nepis space lounge if they're looking to get wasted.
Huh, I'll hit up Nepis in that case.
Hi, have you seen a professor type with a Bobolan sidekick knocking about this joint? Both possibly on the far side of inebriated?
Ohh, I don't know... without an infusion of bubblytastic, my memory receptors do not quite link to my synapses...
Oh, yes, I've heard of that condition! What is it you need to get the signals flowing?
A Magnetar Juice would fit the bill.
Allow me to fix you up...
There you go, one Magnetar Juice. Those receptors tingling yet?

Oh yeah! You're talking about Moonsprocket, right? We were engaged to be married but then he ran off with a rhinocitroll tamer to Plural Z from what I heard. If I ever get my hands on him I'll... What was I talking about? Without an infusion of bubblytastic, my memory receptors do not quite link to my synapses...
Hmm... on to Plural Z, then.
Have you seen a mad old professor with a slug sidekick knocking about here?
Those clowns? I had to eject them a little while ago... Are you going to settle their tab?
I'm just looking for them. Where did they go?

Tell you what, I got some loansharks out for my blood. I sent them on a wild goose chase and now they're out near Marktesh station. It won't take long until they realize they've been duped. If you help me take care of them, I'll help you. What do you say?
I suppose if you close that tab too it's a deal. I'll be back soon.
Hmm, all quiet. I'll bet they're hiding in the asteroid field, preparing to ambush the barkeeper. I should take a closer look and see if I can flush them out.
Hey, what are you doing here? You're blowing our cover!
You got it all wrong, guys. I'm the one who's hunting you!
I never did like loan-sharks. Now back to the bar.
Ok, those guys you told me about have been "taken care of." Where is Moonsprocket?

Damn! You really mean business! I didn't expect you to... Moonsprocket and Lampeter took off to the Pescal Inartu system. He was on the trail of some rare exquisite off some dodgy trader. I'll close that tab. You're welcome back anytime mister...
Exquisite? What the heck does that mean? Anyway, don't go borrowing off dodgy traders again, eh?.
Ok, I should search the lounges of Pescal Inartu. I hope I find these characters soon. I'm getting tired of all this lounge-hopping... Too much like my academy days.
Hmm, they don't seem to be here. I better check the other lounges.
Sorry, buddy, those guys left here ages ago. We still haven't gotten the stains off the walls.
This place looks too orderly to have had a visitation from our friends. I'll have to keep looking.
Old Moonie and Brillo? Yeah, they did the cabaret show in here not too long ago! Haha, they were a laugh! They were so out of their brains, I doubt they could have gotten very far...
Bzzt! Zip! Crackle! Whoooo!
Professor Moonsprocket, I presume!
Burble! Whaaa! Zoink, zoink! Pizz!
Um, something's not right here... Dr. Lampeter?
Honk honk! Yazoo! Pip pip!
Oh, boy. I better talk to the bartender and find out what these guys are on!
Maxwell!
Mkkt Bkkt! This is just getting weirder! What are you doing here?
Welcome Keith! The admins of Maissa were kind enough, or I should say bribable enough to let me set up shop here. Care for a Pescal Inartu frivolity?
It is nice to see you again, Mkkt Bkkt, but I'm here on serious business. You see these two characters?
Ah, the old professor and his shrink!
I need them sobered up and out of here fast. They're needed on a top secret mission.

Hmm, you might have a bit of a problem there, Maxwell. They're off their rockers on Flabbergasters! It will be some time until they're fit to travel anywhere or speak coherently. Come back later and try again!
That won't do! Isn't there an antidote?
Well, yes, there is something... But... Are you sure about this, Maxwell?
It requires something stupidly dangerous, doesn't it...

Of course it does! The anti-fungal extract, K'mirrk Toad Mutagen, is acidic and highly volatile. It can be purchased on Bak S'ondorr. Here are the coordinates. But you'll need to take extra special care in transporting it.
Oh well, if there's nothing else for it.... I better get going.
Hey, I heard that I can buy some K'mirrk Toad Mutagen here.
Yes, you can get it at the shop. You're not going to carry this stuff off-station, are you? A brave or foolish man you would be.
What do you mean?

Well it's not the most stable product. It has to be treated with absolute caution. You won't be able to use your booster too much or make any sudden moves or... BANG! And better stay out of trouble or...BANG, too!
Okay, useful safety tip. Thanks for the info.
I should buy the stuff at the shop, then.
I got the K'mirrk Toad Mutagen. Now back to Moonsprocket. I gotta take this real easy. Might take a while...
Meanwhile, back on Thynome station...
I hope Keith is alright. I start to get nervous when he doesn’t answer the hails.
If the systematic accumulation of dark matter in the secondary orbital range is in turn assimilated into the burst pattern. Hmm, did you say something, Carla?
Since Keith and I have been living together I’ve been feeling more and more, like, I don’t know... Like there needs to me MORE!
Ah, yes! Co-dependency in the subatomic marginal range could lead to super-absorbency in the burst pattern, reducing the likelihood of matter compatibility.
It’s like my instinct tells me to keep Keith close, for us to fly off to a safe haven and start our own little moon-farm.
The mysteries of Terran instinct, primordial echoes interwoven in the genetic memory, one of my earliest studies on the Terran home planet... Although they thought they were studying me...
Oh, if we could go somewhere like that, where the air is not recycled but organically produced!
Is it photosynthesis you refer too?
We’re not on the same wavelength at all, are we?
Are you speaking of ionic or phonemic wavelengths?
Gah!
Stealth fighters! Just what I need!
Okay, I've got the antidote! Let's get it into them right away!
Careful with that stuff or you'll blow their heads off!
Bzzt! Crackle! Prrp! Mkkt! Fungle! Bkkt! Mkkt Bkkt! Aha! Another round, please good man!
Not likely, professor... My name is Keith T. Maxwell. You have work to do back on Thynome!
Ah, the famous Keith T. Maxwell! To what do I owe the pressure?
My aching brain organs! What a rude awakening! Hair of the dog, good sir!
Come on, I have to get you two to Thynome. You'll both have to squeeze into one seat, but I'm sure you'll manage... Mkkt, we'll meet again, old pal!
We always do! Farewell old friend!
Back to Thynome, then!
Professor Moonsprocket. I am truly glad to have you back. I feel I must apologize for judging you so harshly. It seems you did have vital information for us after all.

I am humbled by your apology, which I gracefully accept. And I am happy to be back. I think that potion Maxwell administered managed to clear out the old neurotransmitters and reinvigorate the old thought processes!
Good. We'll need you in top form to explain to us what all this means...
The plasma array, yes! It's an anti-anti-matter projector!
Anti-anti-matter... Isn't that just matter?
It’s not "matter", and it’s not "not-matter" ... it’s "not-not-matter"! Who amongst us has the scientific degree, my boy? Leave the important work to the professionals, please!
Bloody hell!
The core of the supernova is a perpetually expanding anti-matter bubble, forcing the star's expansion. We simply need to direct anti-anti-matter into that core to reverse the process.
We gathered as much from the construction plans you left. But how do we generate anti-anti-matter?

Now there's an age-old question that perplexed many an ancient empire! I was at an archaeological dig in the Paréah system some decades ago when a Nivelian colleague stumbled upon several rare antique prisms.

I now have proof that these same prisms, when arranged into the plasma array on my discovered construcition plans, can concentrate effluvium from specific gas clouds found throughout the galaxy and transform it into the ultra-complex anti-anti-matter.
Makes sense.
We only need to ask a loan of said prisms to apply the process to the plasma array construction. The last I heard from my colleague, he deposited them in the Nivelian Vaults of Névan.
That's something I can help with. I'll go and get those prisms. You all just be ready for when I'm back.
The plans for the array should all be in order, so you don't need me for that part. But Maxwell, I'd better accompany you. My credentials will surely open doors.
Agreed. But please try to avoid any stopovers at space lounges...
Not at all! I'm quite enjoying my breather after that refreshing detox!
Uh, okay... In that case, let's make this quick.
This is Homespace Security. State your destination and intent.
This is Thadellonius Moonsprocket of the Trans-Galactic Academy here to see Curator Dr. Gum'Skratch.
Thank you, professor, you are indeed passed for clearance.
Huh, so I guess our professor here is somewhat renowned!
Okay, here we are, Professor.
Allow me to do the talking, Maxwell. I know the lingo!
Moonsprocket! I must say your visit is quite unexpected. Was there something in particular I could help you with?
Gum'Skratch, how nice to see you again after all these years. We have come in search of the Paréah prisms. It is of some scientific interest that we may be allowed to examine the specimens once more.

You may be out of luck there, my dear colleague. The prisms were dispatched some time ago to a convention on Lopat. However, we lost contact with the freighter and it never reached its destination. Space is an awfully dangerous place these days, it seems...
Oh, yes, I know what you mean! Full of brigands and scoundrels of every calibre... Ah, which reminds me, allow me to introduce Keith Maxwell!
Uh. Hi, yeah. Wait, the prisms aren't here? Did you find out what happened to the freighter?
We sent a search patrol after it. Unfortunately it led into pirate reclaimed territory, so they had to turn back.
Didn't the freighter contain a black box? Maybe something can be salvaged?

I can provide you with the original route map, but obviously I cannot account for your safety if you decide to follow. It must be rife with scoundrels intent on plunder! I have the black box codes here on this floppy disk.
Um, what? Floppy... Disk?
Yes, don't you know? It's a form of obsolete memory that's neither round, nor flaccid!
A gentleman after my own tastes in data storage!
Uh, okay. Let's see if I can trace that freighter on its planned route. Those prisms are of the utmost importance.
Lead the way, Maximilius! I'll just have a little snooze here in the back cabin. All this excitement is making me woozy.
Let's see if I can pick up a signal from the freighter's black box.
Scanning for the black box...
Scanning for the freighter's black box.
Searching for the freighter...
Let's see if this is the right place. Scanning...
Hmm... No reading. The freighter must be somewhere else.
Nothing. On to the next one.
Bad luck. No reading. The freighter must be somewhere else.
Damn it. I'm not picking up any signal.
Nothing. It's like searching for a tweeble in a squayhatch.
I'm picking up a signal! Setting a course for the black box!
This must be what's left of the freighter. There are several secure containers in the debris field. If I dock on to them, maybe I can hack them.
Hey, another treasure hunter. See, I told you we should check out the wreckage. There must be something valuable left.
Sorry chaps, I'm claiming salvage rights on this lot...
I found the black box. But no prisms. On to the next container.
Bad luck again. I hope the other containers yield something.
Nothing important. What a waste of time. There's only one container left.
Bingo! This must be one of the prisms.
This was the last container. So the question is... where are the other prisms? Terran Intelligence should be able to decipher the data on this black box. Maybe we can find a lead.
Hi Brent, I need to ask some help from your Intel division.
Of course, we'll help any way we can. Deep Science kept me briefed about your mission. How's progress?

The prisms were on a freighter in transit to a convention when it was destroyed by pirates. I've successfully salvaged one of the prisms, but the other three are missing. I have a black box from the wreckage. Maybe we can learn something from it.
Okay. Why don't you come back to Alioth and we'll take a look at it together.
I'm on my way.
Meanwhile, in the Nivellian sector...
Chief director, the Midorian refugees are gathered in orbit around Hamina. How shall we proceed?

Discretely, Commander! The processing is to be kept out of view and offline. I want our Nivelian compatriots separated and sent to the repatriation camps. Soon we'll have them back on our side and marching to the front lines, swelling your ranks.
Our forces are overstretched at present. New recruits would be most welcome. But what shall we do with the non-Nivelian refugees?
The others, let's not dispose of them quite yet. Keep them on ice. You never know when we might need them as a bargaining chip.
Your orders will be carried out to the word, Chief Director.
Dismissed.
*Yawn* Are we there yet?
What?! Drats, I totally forgot you were still on board.
I just had a little nap. Quite comfy back here, you know...
Look, just wait there while I figure out what to do with you.
Hi Brent. Here's the black box I told you about.
Good. Let's have a look. Hmm, okay. The signature of one of the attacker's ships is rare but not unknown. I'll cross-check with the list of wanted criminals... Real badass this one.
I need to find this guy. He might be in possession of the other three prisms.
I'll give you access to the Wanted Boards. There are terminals on every Terran station. Check them regularly for the latest info on the criminals’ whereabouts. You can track him down this way.
Thanks Brent. Can you do me a favor and transfer the prism to Thynome?

Sure, we'll have it transferred to the Deep Science team. They've relocated to Var Lupra where they've begun construction on the plasma array platform. Once you have the other prisms, deliver them directly there.
Ok. Thanks, Brent. Um, do you mind taking a little something extra along with that shipment? I have a very sleepy professor on my vessel that might be of some use.
Alright, you win! What is it you want from me? Can't you just leave a guy in peace?
Not this time. You have something I want. The Paréah prisms.
Not me, buddy, I don't have them. But I know what you're talking about. Kehnor must have them. I have no interest in such useless chunks of crystal.
Okay, I should search for Kehnor then. He must be on the wanted list, too.
Okay, alright! I submit! You want the crystal, right?
There should be three of them.
Cut me a break and I'll tell you everything you need to know.
Start talking!
I sold one to a mining operation on Dekato. The other, I had to offer the Vossk for safe passage when they cornered me in their zone.
I'll transfer the one I have to your ship, just leave me to count my losses and start over. An honest start, I swear.
Okay, for cooperating, I'll let you go. Just don't let me see you in this end of the galaxy again, understood?
Hey man, I know when I'm being given a second chance. I do my research. I'm not suiciding myself against the guns of the notorious Keith T. Maxwell.
Before I continue with my search I should head to Var Lupra to deliver the second prism.
So that's the plasma array platform. That's some serious bit of construction! I'd love to know how it works, but it probably involves a long lecture from Khador.
Ah, Keith, you've brought us another prism, how promising!
Khador, are you confident of Moonsprockets plans?

Unfortunately, yes. Every simulation of the plasma array in action points to our success. Despite Moonsprocket's unorthodox methods, he is capable of recognizing rather obscure connections, an exceptional and rare skill.

As you may have noticed on your arrival, we have altered an outdated Midorian space station in order to mount the plasma array. When the structure is complete and the prisms installed, we will unleash its anti-anti-matter projections upon the supernova, so to speak.
Well, I still have two more prisms to find. My next lead is at a mining operation at Dekato. The Vossk have the last prism.
Oh, dear. I do hope we can persuade the Vossk to comply with our wishes.
Don't worry. I already have an idea around that one. But first I'll try the mining operation.
Meanwhile in the Nivelian sector...

Chief Director, we are receiving reports that the Terrans and Midorians are collaborating on new technology to combat the supernova using a secret science program. Keith T. Maxwell is aiding them in their efforts.
The supernova event has been used to our full benefit so far. We can't have anyone interfere. Prepare the contingency plans. We may need to take extreme measures.
Understood, Chief Director.
Your reputation precedes you, Mr. Maxwell, but what interest would you have with our humble mining operations?
I've reason to believe you recently bought a Paréah prism. I'm sorry to inform you that it is stolen goods to which the Terran Fleet lay claim.
Aw, that's just what we need right now! The prism is being used as an energy source for our blast furnaces in the Skavac system. We have tight schedules to fulfill.
Millions of lives depend on it and I don't have much time.

Millions of lives? I regret to hear that, Mr. Maxwell, but we can't simply shut down operations instantly. The prism needs to be cooled, and the assignment finished or else we go bankrupt and thousands will lose their jobs!
Listen, I can understand your predicament, and I can be a reasonable man when I know I'm dealing with honest people. I'll help you finish your last contract in exchange for the prism. How's that?
Let's make it a deal! We need quite a large sum of resources to complete the order. Talk to the foreman at Coromesk, he'll tell you what needs to be done.
I wouldn't want the miners to lose their jobs. I'll go to Coromesk, but this better not take too long.
Are you Maxwell?
Yes. For all intents and purposes your temporary employee, I suppose.
Boss told us you were coming. We need 140 tons of Titanium before we can shut down the furnaces. If you can deliver it to the platforms, we'll handle it from there.
Right. Let's get this done quickly.
We're being attacked by pirates! Every life-form for itself!
Pirates, well, I suppose it's a break from stealth fighters.
Halfway done... It feels as if I'm wasting valuable time on this task.
Looks like we've got more company. They just can't get enough...
Thanks, Maxwell, that's all we need. Our order is secure. We will uninstall the prism and transfer it to your vessel right away.
Great. I should bring it to Var Lupra immediately.
Keith, you got the third prism! I hope this all ends soon. It's hard for me not having you around. Have you thought about the curtains? I'm still waiting on an answer!
Curtains? Carla, there are more urgent matters at the moment. Khador, how's progress coming on the plasma array?

The logistics have been tricky, but we've managed to get the rig to a serviceable stage. Once ready, we can start planning our charging and firing strategy. But we need the last prism first, of course.
I know. I have a plan on that front.
I heard the Vossk have the final prism. Oh, do be careful, Keith! You don't exactly have the best history with them.
It shouldn't be that difficult. I'll be going to B'akrram and see an old friend of mine...
Unknown vessel! State your purpose and destination.
This is Keith T. Maxwell. I'd like to pay a social visit to Mekant Orskk.
Counsellor Orskk? Really? Please hold, I'll call him.
Counsellor? He went up the ranks, my my...
You may proceed to the conference area.
Ah, Mekant! It's been a while!
What is the meaning of this! Why do you come here!
I wanted a word with you in private.
I never wanted to see you again after last time. I don't want to be bothered...
So you're a bigshot now! Counsellor?
Counsellor to the Imperial throne. It is an honorable position!
All the more reason you wouldn't want anyone to know about that little ship-hijacking job we did together that time. Remember? The K'Suukk?
I paid my dues to Alice by bringing you to that ship. I owe nothing more. You can't blackmail me.
Sure I can.
Uhm...
Want to try me?
What is it you want?
The Paréah prism.
Hah! That prism is kept at a very secure location, Maxwell, while we conduct tests on its military potential. You'll never find a way into it.
Try me... I've done it before... Where is it, Mekant?
Why you impertinent... You have no leverage over me, Maxwell. I can just have you killed right now.

Don't you think I thought of that before I came here? Somewhere near the Vossk border I have a drone satellite with a time release data transmitter and the clock is ticking down. And when it does send its signal, it'll cause one heck of a major political scandal.
You're bluffing...
What if I'm not?

Oh, Maxwell... Okay, it's in the cargo bay of a battleship at Bra'Murr. You can retreive the prism by hacking into the board computer. It will be automatically loaded on your ship. But leave me out of this. You're on your own from here.

Much obliged, Mekant. Nobody ever needs to know about our conversation, and nobody needs to know about any past indiscretions. But I'll be keeping that satellite primed until my task is complete, so don't even think of double-crossing me, okay?
Get out, Maxwell, and never darken my hangar door again.
So now all I need to do is figure out how to get to Bra'Murr without being noticed. I'll need a Vossk ship and the right signature for cover. I'll pick those up on the Loma black market.
Then I'll hack into the cargo bay and have it loaded on my ship.
Just my luck! Mekant didn't say anything about there being two battleships! Which one is the prism on? *Sigh* Only one way to find out...
Cripes, no prism on the cargo list. And my cover is blown! I have to get to the other ship.
Unauthorised intrusion detected.
Scramble defenses. Apprehend the infiltrator.
It's on the list. I'm having a cargo bot transfer it to my ship... This should take a moment.
Yeah! I've got the prism. That was really too close. I should get to Var Lupra quickly.
Aha! It's the intrepid Maxwell with the final prism! Hoorah!
Hearty congratulations dear sir! Hic!
Why, thank you, gentlemen! How are things looking here?
Excellent, but for the continued menace of these phantom assailants...
Um, stealth fighters?
Yes, those are the blighters! Been haranguing us around the clock! Has your friend Commander Snocom kept fairly occupied!
So what's next, are we ready to fire this plasma array up or what?
Patience, lad! We've only begun the fuel processing and it's proving to be a tiresome chore. We hadn't reckoned on needing so much chromo-plasma to charge the array!

If you're so eager to help, and it seems you are, pay a visit to Gunant Breh on Var Hastra and he'll show you how you help gather the remaining elements. Here's the blueprint, which should make clear to you our remaining needs.
What, we still need more items for the plasma array? Ugh, I'll go talk to Gunant then. I should get going before Carla sees me and tries to stall me.
Fare thee well, valiant champion of the stars! Hic!
Um, yeah, see you later, Doctor Lampeter.
There you are, Keith, old friend! You've come on plasma assignment?
That I have. What's it all about, Gunant?
Gas clouds. You'll never have seen them, as they're invisible to the naked eye, but they're there, everywhere. You need a special filter to be able to spot them.
You also need to equip your ship with ionizing missiles to solidify them, and a collector to vacuum up the good stuff.
Some of the extractions can be highly volatile, you'll need to fly carefully so as not to blow yourself to bits.
Yeah, I have some experience with that.

I'll provide you with a slightly-used collector and a simple scan filter. There are better products on the market with more features, like projecting the location of the gas clouds on the radar, but these will just have to do for now.
Ok, thanks, Gunant.
There are also fifteen ionizing missiles in the hangar. The last few, I'm afraid, we're in short supply. Here's a blueprint in case you need more.
Meet me at Kernstal with a filter, a collector and at least fifteen ionizing missiles equipped, and I'll run you through the basics.
Equipped your filter? Great! Follow me to the waypoint and stop your engine when you're there.
There's a nice juicy gas cloud for you! See it? Right in front of me. Get close, but not too close.
Hey, I never knew these things were floating out here! Fancy that!
Fire the ionizing missile. Manually detonate it in range. Then change to turret view and suck up that gunk with your collector!
There you go! Easy, huh?
Great. That wasn't so hard. But the shopping list for required plasma is quite long. Any more tips to offer, Gunant?
Well, this is the prime gathering zone for the green plasma. The blue plasma can be found near the Aquila system. Look for purple plasma in the Pescal Inartu area.
And what about the red plasma?

Oh yes, you'll have a lot of fun with that. It's only found deep in Vossk territory. And if that's not bad enough, that's the most explosive type you'll encounter. We can't find many volunteers willing to take that stuff on board.
Oh, brilliant. I better get to work, then.
Ah, it's Keithius Maximus! The man we've been waiting for!
Good going! A solid man of many means indeed!
Thanks to your efforts in obtaining the required plasma, we can begin charging up the array at once! Take your seats ladies, gents and persons of alien persuasions, the show is about to begin!
How exciting! After all this hard work!
Now, with this knob we inject the required amount of the chromo-plasma to the array chambers... And now to save the galaxy... Mr Khador, would you do the honours and please, at your convenience.

Oh my! What an honour! I suppose I should take this opportunity to make a short speech before we commence this most historic occasion. My earliest memory of studying quasar pulsations was when I was still but a yearling in my wet-nurses tentacles... I looked up at the stars and noticed... wait, what's that?
This is a message from the Nivelian Republic.
You are ordered at once to cease in your illegal operations on reclaimed Nivelian space! You are trespassing.
That's Trunt Harval with a guard of stealth fighters! So he was behind the attacks all the time. What a two-faced...
The Midorian experiment is being terminated for the treasonous abomination it is. Those who capitulate now will be returned to the Nivelian fold. Those who resist will feel our thunder.
They're after the plasma array! We must defend it at all costs!
Say goodbye to your ridiculous plans!
That should teach you a lesson.
This is terrible! What are we going to do now? Keith, come back to the station, we need to plan our next move.
Disaster! Calamity! Tragedy and misfortune!
Think positively, Khador, we need you now! My scans indicate various intact parts among the debris.
Yes, yes, of course, I should maintain decorum in a crisis. Let me see... Our scans do indeed detect that all four prisms are in the immediate proximity and are salvageable.
The chromo-plasma is scattered but we can send out crews to collect it before it disperses. The platform arms are floating loose and need to be secured. But the platform is gone! In smithereens!
Damn it! Where are we going to find a replacement on that scale. There must be something we can use for a platform.
There is one obvious candidate... But I'm not certain that you would appreciate the suggestion, Dr. Paolini...
What is it, Khador? Quick-thinking is what we need right now.
Well... Valkyrie!
Oh, gods, no!

Khador's right, Carla. Valkyrie is about the only ready-made structure this end of the galaxy with a thick enough hull to support the array this close to the supernova. Looks like I'll have to pay your sister a visit!
Just do whatever needs to be done, Keith. Get Valkyrie back here, and don't fall for any of Alice's ruses. You know what she's like.
I know how to handle her...
Alice, come in. This is Keith speaking.
Alice... We need to talk!
Maxwell, you ape! What is it you want?
I'll lay my cards on the table, Alice. You've been out here long enough. We're willing to offer you amnesty in return for the station.
Now that's an interesting proposal. But do you really expect me to just hand over my home to you and leave me with nothing?
We'll sweeten the deal, Alice. We'll relocate you, in comfort, wherever you want.

Wherever I want? Oh, the possibilities! I do have my basic needs, you know, Maxwell. Someplace quiet, exclusive, in Terran space, with a vista on a... um, blue planet. No less than tech level 5. Find this for me and we've got a deal.
Ugh, can't you be any more complicat... *Sigh* Okay, I'll see what I can do.
And don't dare come back here without something really nice, Maxwell. If it's not suitable, I'll make your life a misery!
Just like her sister... She'll be sending me out shopping for wall-hangings next. Now, to find a real-estate agent on a Terran station around a blue-planet. I guess I'll start in the space lounges.
This looks like suitable system for Alice. Now let's find a real estate broker.
Are you looking to buy or just browsing? I don't want any time-wasters.
Oh, no, I'm in the market alright. I need an apartment for a distinguished lady. She can be quite choosy...

A distinguished lady, eh? We have a nice little bedsit below the hangar deck, right next to the heating turbines, so no worry about the bills. Perfect for watching the comings and goings of our visiting traders.
No, not quite what we had in mind. I'd better search somewhere else. Thanks for your time!
Time-waster!
Greetings! Do you by any chance have a spacious apartment with a pleasant view?
How does 400 square meters sound? Jacuzzi, 6 bedrooms, pool table and bar and a huge dining room! It's prime real-estate, and popular too!
Uh, sounds nice. But... What do you mean by popular?
The apartment has about sixty-four tenants now, mostly multipods and some Bobolans. Which leaves room for sixteen more!
No, not quite what we were thinking of. My client is a fussy type, might not get along with the housemates. I'll pass.
Hi, I'm looking for a place for an acquaintance of mine. Big enough with a nice view. Not sharing.
Not sharing? Ooh, la-di-da! Who's it for, the Queen of Moogaresh or something? No, not here, I'm afraid, buddy. Don't you know there's a housing crisis on with all the refugees about?
Right, okay. I'll keep looking.
I'm looking for an apartment.
Have you found it?
No, not yet, that's why I'm talking to you.
We currently have a penthouse available with stunning planetary views, two sleeping-pods, anti-gravity bathtub, fashionable decor. But I very much doubt it would be in your price range.
Oh yeah? Well it sounds perfect to me. I'll take it. Requisitioned on behalf of the Terran Fleet.
What? You can't do this. But it's preposterous! This property is worth millions!
Take it up with Fleet Command.
Now back to Alice to give her the good news.
Hi, Alice! I've found you a place on Kalun Amir station. It fits all your specifications.
Oh, wonderful! How overjoyed I am!
Now just help me get out of Void space, and we'll consider the transaction complete.
Can't you move it?
No, you crummdutch! You left me stranded here without fuel, remember?
*Sigh* Okay, how much do you need.
A thousand energy cells to get me out of here.
That's a heck of a lot of energy cells. I better ask Brent at Alioth station if they can spare it from Fleet reserves.
Maxwell! How are you coming along with Valkyrie?
Alice has agreed to hand over the station, but we need thousand energy cells to move it. I've requisitioned some alternative accommodation for her on Kalun Amir in return for her cooperation.

I suppose she's done her time in limbo long enough. Best we take it without any struggle, we don't want it damaged. I'll prepare our newest Khador-drive freighter with the energy cells on board. I'm sending Hans with you to pilot the station back. Hans?
Yeah, boss.
Meet Keith T. Maxwell.
Hi.
Hi. Um. Brent, how's it going with the Nivelian conflict?

They're regrouping along the border, but we really have no idea when they'll launch their next attack. Our resources are too limited for a pre-emptive strike. The stealth fighters are keeping us pretty busy.
And the supernova?

Still expanding. We've evacuated the last of the Midorians from the affected area. It almost seems as if the Nivelians couldn't have planned this situation any better if they were planning to crush the Midorian faction.
Yes, it does all seem a little too convenient for them. Hold the fort, Brent, and I'll take care of Valkyrie. We'll crack this thing yet.
Oh boy, a welcoming party! What is this?
Ah, Maxwell! So you've returned, and you've brought the energy cells I asked for. You are so predictable.
I don't understand. Why would the Void fighters be acting on Alice's commands? This is bizarre!
Now, kindly bring the freighter forward so we can unload the energy cells, and I'll let you live.
You won't get away with this, Alice.
This is laughable, Maxwell! I've had plenty of time to plot my revenge. Send the freighter forward!
I have to stall for time. I'll better do what she says for now. Freighter captain? Proceed to Valkyrie.
Excellent! A wise move, Maxwell... Void minions, terminate him!
We are slightly outnumbered and Valkyrie is powering up! We've got approximately 90 seconds before it's ready to launch the engines. Hans, any ideas?
Try to dock at Valkyrie! We'll enter through the airlock. Scans show only one woman and half a man on board.
Good idea! Time is short!
Ready to go on board. Let us waste no time and head straight for the bridge!
You just had to try it, didn't you, Alice!
Get off my station! You have no right to be here.
You're in more trouble than you realize... What the... Tenner? Corny?
ZTDON OBZFD JMNG XWXFR!
What happened to you? Alice, what have you done to him!
Cornelius willingly volunteered for some neural rewiring. By splicing Void tissue with his brain, we've been able to grow some new cognitive processes whereby he can speak Void! Isn't that amazing?
FTBKK SECZZZ ZBGCJ LPFEV NNRXD!
It's monstrous! You are one sick, delusional cookie. Can it be reversed? What's he saying?

Well, that's the downside. He can speak Void, but he no longer speaks Terran. At least he understands what we are saying. It has worked to our advantage. The Voids have been ever so nice to us since we put Cornelius on the frequency!
TZCTH IHJFR NJBZZ.
That's the limit. Hans, place this madwoman under arrest.
I have furthered science! I should be hailed for my genius!
Oh, poor Corny! Don't worry old guy, I'll take you to Deep Science and we'll see what can be done to fix you.
FCCCZ ZNFRCR EVG!
Maxwell, the station is operational and can be moved to Var Lupra.
Make it so! I'll take the prisoner with me to be on the safe side.
Brent? I have Alice in custody. She resisted in the end. A bit of a strange twist.
Tell us about it later. For now, bring her to Damarque station. I'll reserve a nice place for her in our cells.
Hear that, Alice? And you could have been sitting pretty in a cosy penthouse by now...
Ah, shutup!
Prisoner Alice Paolini for you. Take extra care, she can be tricky.
This way, Paolini. You won’t be seeing any stars for a while to come.
You can't do this to me! I'm important! I deserve better than this treatment. Unhand me, you simian, you're not worthy of contact with me! Let me go at once! I've served my time in Void space.
And it has obviously driven you mad. I'm sorry that I have to do this to you, Alice. You're Carla's sister after all. But you must pay for your crimes. Goodbye.

Maxwell. Valkyrie is being fitted out as we speak. Khador was right, it's the perfect platform replacement and the prism arms attach seamlessly. Let's get to the defences at Var Lupra. The Nivelians will doubtless try to stop us again. Make sure you're fully prepared, I can feel a fight in my old bones.
Well advised! I'll be there shortly.
Wow, the whole Terran armada is here!
Glad you made it, Mr Maxwell! The plasma array has been promptly reassembled and fitted to Valkyrie. We can initiate the sequence any moment now!
Third time lucky!
Despite my warnings, you persist in meddling with destiny. Now you shall feel the wrath of Nivelian might! We will show no mercy.
I thought as much... Keith! Concentrate your fire on Harval's ship. Everyone else, take care of those stealth fighters!
I'm on it.
Keith, Control has been hit! We've lost communication with the plasma array!
Damn! That's bad news!
What is that? Alice?
Hi everyone! While you kiddies have been playing sticks and stones, I've got my station back! Teehee! Thanks for the awesome add-on! Well, bye bye now! I'm off to have some fun!
She got on board! Alice took control of the plasma array!
That madwoman is ruining everything. It's a good thing we removed the Khador drive, so she can't get far. Go after her!
Not so fast! You're not going anywhere!
Alice! What are you doing? This is craziness! The lives of billions depend on this plasma array. Do you really want to be remembered for this?
Leave me alone, Maxwell. This is my station! Now, why is this damn Khador Drive not working?
We removed it. You've nowhere to go, Alice. But there's still time to do the right thing. Fire the plasma array!
Oh, cruds! I've been hit! I never wanted it to come to this. I just wanted my station back. Oh, to hells with it. Send my little sister my love!
Wow, it really did work! The sun is back to normal! Alice... thank you!
Seems like I was blown miles off. What about Harval? I hope he...
It's not over yet, Maxwell. The Nivelian supremacy will prove itself. We may have missed this opportunity, but we will find another Midorian star to activate.
The supernova? That was you? Harval, you monster! You'll pay for this!
Yes, a Nivelian probe triggered the supernova. We couldn't allow the Midorian rebels to thrive in new space. Something had to be done. Now, let's end this.
You'll never beat me, Maxwell!
You've already lost, Harval! Your plan has failed and so will you!
You're tough but that's not enough!
We will see about that!
Why are you still alive? Die already!
The end of a dictator.
Brent? Can you hear me?
Keith! You're alive!

Yeah, I made it! Trunt Harval is dead. I got a confession out of him beforehand. It seems the Nivelians sent a probe which triggered the supernova. This was all part of a larger plan to wipe out the Midorians.

A fanatic! This whole affair has proved so unpopular among the Nivelian faction that there's an uprising underway. With the confession you extracted from him, we can make sure this is the last of Harval's junta. There's still a few henchmen to take care of, however. We're regrouping back on Thynome, why don't you join us.
Alright Brent, see you there... It's kind of hard to believe, though, that it's all over.
Hooray for the man of the hour!
Well done, old chap!
The new Nivelian regime is offering to release all the Midorian refugees. Apparently they had been shipped to reeducation camps throughout the whole nivelian sector.
Harval really was a madman! Glad to hear the refugees are safe. Oh, um... Carla... I was there with Alice at the end... What she did was really brave...
I know. I'm sad about it, but I felt like I lost my sister a long time ago. Maybe now she has redeemed herself, somehow.
DDERZ IJRD WYTGZH ZBTDC!
Indubitably!
Hahahahaha!
How about we get a round in and have a toast to Alice and the prospects of a brighter... I mean more secure, Midorian future!
Drinks! Ah yes, that's my language! Bottoms up and all that!
Hooray!
The next morning...
A letter from Keith! He didn't come home last night... Why do I have a bad feeling about this...

Dear Carla,
I'm off for a drink. 
See you!
Keith
Oh, Keith... You... Crummdutch!
Meanwhile on Maissa...
Here we are, gentlemen. Three of our Flabbergaster specialities as per requested.
So now I get to see if these are really as good as you guys claim!
Oh, yes! Mr. Bkkt offers some of the finest exquisite this side of the Silky Way!
Well, here goessszzt! Bzzt! Fwipp! Brrraaappp!
Oh, so that's what it looks like from the other side!
Indubitablzzt! Brrp! Zooiiiooo! Frappp!
Damn it. Someone found me!
There's the man I need to talk to. Get ready for some negotiations Keith T. Maxwell style.
I found him! Get ready for some negotiations Keith T. Maxwell style.
Damn it. Someone found me!
Damn it. Someone found me!
I'd like to have a word with you!
I'm not in the mood!
I'd like to have a word with you!
I'm not in the mood!
Another of the Galaxy's Most Wanted to take care of.
He's on the wanted list. Time to cash in!
Time for some bounty hunting!
I'm collecting the bounty on this one.
Get ready for a fight, I won't be leaving here without the bounty on your head.
Ha, you're after the bounty, right? You don't scare me at all.
Oh no, he must be after the bounty on my head.
Crud! Another bounty hunter.
Kiss your bounty goodbye, you're not getting out of here in one piece.
A bounty hunter? You won't stand a chance against me.
A job well done.
And that's that!
Another successful bounty hunt.
Ah, a nice little boost to my credit account.
Good riddance to bad rubbish.
Hey, what is this? Some kind of blueprint for a sentry gun. T'Suum, now that could come in handy.
Hey, what is this? Some kind of blueprint for an ionization missile. Ion Lambda Mk2, now that could come in handy.
Hey, what is this? Some kind of blueprint for a leech beam. Pandora Leech, now that could come in handy.
Hey, what is this? Some kind of blueprint for a shield. Particle Shield, now that could come in handy.
Gunant warned me about the red plasma being highly explosive. I have to take extra care when having it on board.
Maxwell! When you get the time, come and see me on Kaamo in the Shima system. I'm sure it will be worth your while.
Maxwell! I've sent a few mechanics to Kaamo. They're offering upgrades for your ships. I've also sent two dealers who are selling special unique ships and items.
